test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 26 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: DEF is related to CDE in a certain way. In the same way, MNO is related to LMN. To which of the following options is UVW related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

DEF is related to CDE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70ca4bb77974bbbd871338d79cc0ee5347ac766c970d712a733f18c9a34d0c8d.png] 

MNO is related to LMN.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/acbf4564d6170aebf26bde1a55c5a19ceabdefe186b4cec94b04bfc56902bd11.png] 

Similarly, UVW will be related:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1f9e527367be99570c7deb9ca63f46be49ae9dbd3662f36145c7e0aefe68490.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "TUV".
